ASPECTS.name: Conjunction
ASPECTS.description: Planets in the same place. Energy is amplified and blended.

ASPECTS.name: Opposition
ASPECTS.description: Planets are opposite each other. Represents polarity, tension, and awareness.

ASPECTS.name: Trine
ASPECTS.description: Planets are 120 degrees apart. Represents ease, flow, and natural talent.

ASPECTS.name: Square
ASPECTS.description: Planets are 90 degrees apart. Represents internal conflict, tension, and drive for action.

ASPECTS.name: Sextile
ASPECTS.description: Planets are 60 degrees apart. Represents opportunity, talent, and friendship that requires effort.

ASPECTS.name: Quincunx
ASPECTS.description: Also called Inconjunct. Represents irritation, adjustment, and blind spots.

ASPECTS.name: Semi-sextile
ASPECTS.description: Planets are 30 degrees apart. Represents subtle growth and mild friction.

ASPECTS.name: Semi-square
ASPECTS.description: Planets are 45 degrees apart. Represents internal friction and agitation.

ASPECTS.name: Sesquiquadrate
ASPECTS.description: Planets are 135 degrees apart. Represents external challenges and need for adjustment.

ASPECTS.name: Quintile
ASPECTS.description: Planets are 72 degrees apart. Associated with creative talent and dynamic energy.

ASPECTS.name: Biquintile
ASPECTS.description: Planets are 144 degrees apart. Associated with mastery, creative will, and arranging things.

VEDIC_DRISHTI.description: In Vedic astrology, aspects (Drishti) are house-based rather than degree-based. All planets aspect the 7th house from themselves with 100% influence. Mars, Jupiter, and Saturn have special aspects.

Rahu.notes: Aspects 5th, 7th, and 9th houses from itself (often considered similar to Jupiter's aspects in modern Jyotish).
